Application Data.NAME: SWEET TREATS CONFECTIONERY
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Treats Confectionery specializes in the retail of a wide variety of candies, chocolates, and confectionery products. Our store offers an inviting atmosphere with an extensive selection of both popular and niche treats, including handmade chocolates and seasonal sweets. Located in a suburban area, we operate from 9 AM to 8 PM, allowing us to cater to families and local residents. We do not offer any food preparation services or hazardous products. The store maintains a secure environment with robust safety measures, including an alarm system and surveillance cameras, ensuring the protection of our inventory and customer safety. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service and creating a delightful shopping experience for candy lovers of all ages.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 10, 2022, a minor slip and fall incident occurred in the store due to a spilled drink, resulting in a claim amount of $1,200. The claim was resolved and settled out of court in October 2022. Status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, Grade 1, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system with 24/7 monitoring, surveillance cameras covering all entrances and exits, motion sensors inside the store, and adequate exterior lighting.

Underwriting Guidelines:
3.43
Convenience Stores
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Convenience stores located in non-urban or suburban areas with limited operating hours
(typically closing before 10 PM), reducing exposure to late-night crime and vandalism.
– Store size under 3,000 sq. ft., which generally correlates with lower inventory and reduced
operational complexity.
– No onsite fuel sales (gasoline, diesel) or hazardous product handling (e.g., propane tanks,
kerosene), minimizing fire, explosion, and environmental contamination risks.
– Demonstrated strong physical security measures such as alarm systems, surveillance
cameras, adequate lighting, and secure cash handling procedures.
– Minimal or no history of claims related to theft, robbery, or liability incidents within the
past 3–5 years.
• Acceptable:
– Stores offering limited food preparation (e.g., pre-packaged sandwiches, coffee service)
and ancillary retail services such as photocopying or lottery ticket sales.
